segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum is hydrating and non-greasy, with one noting it sustained skin through five months in a tropical climate and another calling it a lifesaver in a desert climate.
segments.combination: One reviewer states the formula suits combination skin, describing instant plumping and a strengthened moisture barrier.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: one with very sensitive skin says it worked perfectly and smoothed her face, while others report the fragrance triggers breakouts or a migraine and had to stop use.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature (50s to 80s) report visibly smoother, firmer, more youthful-looking skin and reduced fine lines after weeks to years of use.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers using this for aging report smoother texture, reduced fine lines and wrinkles, firmer and more radiant skin, often after weeks of use; a couple of reviewers say it did not visibly reduce their wrinkles despite the price.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the serum leaves skin hydrated, plump and non-greasy, with several noting it helps with tightness and moisture even in dry or hot climates; one review says it left skin feeling tacky rather than absorbed.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product helped calm redness on her face; this is a single mention.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the serum strengthens the moisture barrier and suits dry to combination skin.
concerns.spots: One long-term user reports visibly reduced scarring and marks from previous cystic acne after switching to this and other Clarins products.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the serum caused breakouts on her face, which she attributes to the fragrance, and now uses it only on hands and feet; another long-term user reports past cystic acne resolved and improved over years.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers note the serum absorbs quickly and does not leave a greasy or oily residue, including those layering it under makeup or sunscreen.

aspects.libelle: Bottle or pump mechanism breaks or jams

extraits.texte: This serum has a very strong scent. I wonder if the fragrance is what is causing my skin to break out. I can't use it on my face, so I started using it on my hands and feet. My skin on those areas looks amazing! If only I could use it on my face

extraits.titre: Product fine, scent a little much
extraits.texte: I really would have loved this product but had a difficult time getting past the scent. I was apparently pretty sensitive to it, not in an allergy type of way, but more along the lines of it being overly flowery and it ended up triggering a migraine for me. That typically seals the deal for me. While the serum was initially "tacky" to the touch after application, it dried nicely. If they made this in an unscented... or even a vanilla based scent, I'd get it again. As it is, I had to return the serum. For those of you not affected by flowery scents, I'd say go for it!

extraits.titre: [received this product in exchange for my honest review]
extraits.texte: Instantly plumps and illuminates the complexion, strengthens the moisture barrier, and suits most skin types from dry to combination . Expensive investment; the strong botanical scent can irritate sensitive or fragrance-averse skin.

I have been using Clarins Double Serum for decades now. I am 56 yo and people look at me and think I am in my 40's. I receive sincere compliments regularly amd get asked what products do I use? My secret is the Clarins Double Serum and other Clarins anti aging products. My skin used to break out, I was a poster child for cystic acne, the Clarins products solved it and years later I have visibly less scarring and marks. Thank you Clarins.

I bought this product seven months ago before traveling to a tropical climate. I used it throughout my five-month stay, and it kept my skin well-hydrated, soft, and healthy-looking despite the heat and humidity. I am very pleased with the results and will definitely buy it again and again.

This product was referred to me by a friend who highly recommended it, I ordered it and I love it. I have a very sensitive skin yet still worked on my skin perfectly. It smooths my face and makes me look more natural and healthy
I bought hoping to help my wrinkles, but it didnt. The price point and results didn't match. Smells nice, absorbs great, but for that kind of money i expected positive results.
